reviews.title: Great value fan!
reviews.comment: Great and affordable alternative to a Noctua fan! If you’re looking for a cooling solution that balances premium build quality with near-silent operation, the ASUS ROG Strix XF120 is an absolute winner. This fan proves that you don't need flashy RGB to make a statement—its performance speaks for itself. What Makes It Stand Out: Whisper-Quiet Operation: True to its name, this fan is incredibly quiet. Even when the RPMs ramp up during heavy gaming sessions, the sound profile is a smooth, low-frequency hum rather than a high-pitched whine. MagLev Bearing Technology: The Magnetic Levitation bearing significantly reduces friction. This not only makes it quieter but also gives the fan an impressive 400,000-hour lifespan. It’s an investment that will likely outlast your next two PC builds. Exceptional Airflow & Pressure: Whether you're using it as a case intake or mounting it to a CPU heatsink/radiator, the XF120 moves a serious amount of air. It manages to keep temps low without needing to run at 100% speed. Premium Build & Aesthetics: The fan feels dense and high-quality in the hand. The pre-installed anti-vibration pads and sleeved cables are thoughtful touches that make installation easy and keep your cable management looking clean.
reviews.author: Techanobi

reviews.title: Updated: Definitely one of my better fans!
reviews.comment: The ASUS XF120 fans really are one of the better, quieter fans in my collection of PC fans. For a couple of weeks, I have been using a pair of these ASUS fans in comparison to other brands I collected in the mail; Noctua, Arctic, Corsair, etc. The initial goal was to find what most people are buying these fans for, air pressure and silence, and in the end, these ASUS XF120 do indeed deliver the results! At first, I made my quick doubts, only purchasing them for the half-off sale that lasted a week or two, believing the 'whisper-quiet' sales pitch would be exaggerated. I am glad to be wrong, after setting these up after some comparisons, these do make some noticeable changes, good changes in air and noise. I put my doubts to rest and aim to use these as my final fan setup. To those on the fence about these, I wouldn't stress on buying these fans with doubts in mind as I have. These do make promises in performance, making my Celsius temps sustainably lower during gaming and cool idle temps too. In my experience and opinion, these make great exhaust fans for 120mm sizes, as the heat is rushing out at faster rates, keeping it cooler inside as air going in. They do great as intake as well, but I mix things up with another brand for now. I bought these at a lower cost than base price, being $15 individually, which is very well worth it. I hope you and everyone finds these at the similar price point!
reviews.author: Louis Ryan

reviews.title: Call me a big "fan"
reviews.comment: These are great! I bought a pair to put on my CPU Cooler which is a Thermalright FS140. The stock fans were fine, but I wanted to try some higher quality fans to upgrade the cooling. Installation was... well, easy. They're just fans and I already had a daisy chain for my other fans. The hard part was getting the metal clamps on the cooler, but that's normal. The fans are super quiet, even at max speed. My gaming temps dropped by around 10c. I used to get 80-90 degrees (don't worry, it's a 7900x which is designed to stay at 95c). With these fans, I'm getting around 70-80c! If it goes under a big load while loading a game, it did get into the 90s for a split second, but otherwise these fans keep my pc at a much cooler temp while gaming. They look great too! No rgb needed
reviews.author: Noor

reviews.title: Quiet at full load
reviews.comment: Excellent fan, very quiet at full rpm. I am using it as a case fan in a small 16.8L matx case and it does a great job at exhaust. My computer used to overheat due to the cramped conditions in the case, and this fan solved the problem.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.comment: I love these fans, they're my go to for 120x25mm. Bought 3 awhile ago for my 360 radiator and they performed extremely well. Efficient and quiet! They were recently on sale so I bought 3 more for push pull setup and extremely satisfied. The build quality is top notch, great protective packaging, etc. Highly recommend, I wish they made these in 140mm because I would buy those as well!
